verdict: Lead cost dropped sharply, but key infrastructure milestones remain overdue.

Google Search and LSA go-live is the immediate priority, and restoring your Google Business Profile activity (dark since August 28) is also in motion. Once those are live, you should see broader lead volume and more stable efficiency numbers in the next reporting period.
